notes.title: --DEFINITIVE UPDATE--
notes.content:
Happy Autumn!

AcroGames is happy to announce that the development of [i]The Finnish War[/i] is coming to an end with this definitive update. After a handful of updates through the year, we are moving on to new challenges!

Of course, one never knows if the need for an update arises still in the unforeseeable future. But for now, this is unlikely.

In this update, you will find:
[list]
[*]graphical fixes
[*]audio fixes
[*]minor bug fixes
[*]added [i]'Scandinavia'[/i] multiplayer map to single-player as well (formerly multiplayer-exclusive)
[*]added descriptions for units to the army deployment phase (no more need to memorize unit descriptions from the Help menu!)
[*]old Campaign save files are now obsolete due to certain patch changes and will be deleted automatically on first launch. State of unlocked content (e.g. Factions unlocked from Campaign playthroughs) is not affected
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 13
notes.content:
Happy Summer To All!

After many months, [i]The Finnish War[/i] is treated with a new update, with small gameplay and performance changes here and there.

[list]
[*]minor graphical fixes/updates
[*]correct factions assigned to Player and CPU during tutorial
[*]more balanced random army generation for players
[*]old Campaign save files are now obsolete due to certain patch changes and will be deleted automatically on first launch. State of unlocked content (e.g. Factions unlocked from Campaign playthroughs) is not affected
[/list]
